evidence.quote: I believe the case for an increase in the federal funds rate has strengthened in recent months.
the FOMC continues to anticipate that gradual increases in the federal funds rate will be appropriate over time
While economic growth has not been rapid, it has been sufficient to generate further improvement in the labor market.
Inflation has continued to run below the FOMC's objective of 2 percent, reflecting in part the transitory effects of earlier declines in energy and import prices.
at some point after the process of raising the federal funds rate is well under way, we will cease or phase out reinvesting repayments of principal from our securities holdings.

parsed.rationale: The near-term remarks signal a strengthened case for a rate hike on the back of solid labor market gains, while inflation is described as below target for transitory reasons. The bulk of the speech is a framework discussion of the policy toolkit with little directional signal.
